root_cause: The tenant AI deployment preference can trigger regulatory, cost, privacy and CSRD review but previously the customer-facing sovereignty panel had no visual status for the assessment.
prevention: Render only the tenant-scoped persisted last_change_impact status in the existing sovereignty panel
Show ESRS topics as pending applicability/materiality review, never measured emissions or legal compliance claims
Escape all source-provided text and never display actor IDs, change IDs or full audit event metadata

evidence.outcome: Customer sees pending review; no new separate dashboard and no invented CSRD compliance
